posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
Ok, before anyone gets too excited, at the time of writing this variant is not actually available.

 

However, this Monday I saw a notification that I had to redownload my Season 1 content, and I was curious why, so I checked the heroes. The only one that indicated it needed to be redownloaded was Guise.

Rather than make a post simply pointing that out, however, I decided to go ahead and make the variant unlock discussion post for it, because!

My guess is, Handelabra sneakily updated the game with his unlock condition, but hasn’t enabled it yet. I also suspect that it will become available once we discover La Comodora’s and Lifeline’s unlock conditions.

I am also pretty sure the community has already discovered his unlock condition.

I’m pretty sure it’s: Unlock every other hero variant via their respective achievements.

If it’s not that, it may be that, …and play at least one full game with each of them.

… I guess we won’t know until it happens, but I wanted to put it out there anyway.
